input.summary: Insert Section 11.4 requiring Commerce One to provide transition assistance and return Corio data on exit
input.comment: [Playbook] We added an exit clause requiring Commerce One, on request, to provide up to six (6) months of transition assistance at its then-current rates and to return our data and Confidential Information in a machine-readable format within thirty (30) days before deleting and certifying deletion. Our playbook requires an orderly wind-down and data return on exit; we can live with a ninety (90) day assistance period if six months is an issue.

ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, and without limiting Corio's rights that survive under Section 11.3, Commerce One shall (i) at Corio's request, provide reasonable transition assistance to Corio and its Customers for a period of up to six (6) months at Commerce One's then-current standard rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of Corio's written request, return to Corio all data of Corio, its Customers and Software Users in Commerce One's possession or control, together with Corio's Confidential Information, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete such data and Confidential Information from its systems and certify such deletion to Corio in writing.
